content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Nagpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://aiimsnagpur.edu.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 20-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the AIIMS Nagpur Various Posts on Deputation is 20 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies for Various Posts on Deputation in AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 56 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary will be as per Level-04 to Level-11 as per the 7th CPC, varying for different posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the eligibility criteria for the posts?
faq.answer: Candidates should be holding analogous posts or with required service in lower grade pay from State/Central Government or Statutory/Autonomous Bodies.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by All India Institute of Medical Sciences Nagpur (AIIMS Nagpur).

faq.question: Q9. What are the selection process steps?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification and Scrutiny of Applications.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the links provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
